enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Remain still. Shift legs. Move arm. Turn again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Cup hands with water. Splash face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Place on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir with spatula. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Place in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes from shoe rack. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door open. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Receive patient assignments. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Assist doctor with procedure. Sterilize equipment. Respond to call light. Walk to another patient room. Check IV drip. Record notes. Consult with nurse. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Update records. Prepare for handover. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add dish soap. Pick up plate. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Pick up glass. Scrub glass. Rinse glass. Place in drying rack. Pick up fork. Scrub fork. Rinse fork. Place in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and running a laundry cycle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Take out clothes. Place clothes in washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press start button. Wait for cycle to start. Check display. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust pillow. Lie back. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water. Put down bottle. Continue watching TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Open reading app. Read book. Turn page. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read book. Turn page. Place bookmark. Put down book. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Shift legs. Turn to right side. Move arm. Turn again. Continue sleeping.
